name: Zeed Finance YEED reflection skim drain
summary: YEED's sell path credited the full reward fee to each of its three reward pairs (USDT, HO and ZEED) on every transfer into a swap pair, minting balance the pairs never received as reserves. The attacker looped skim() between the three pairs, harvesting the growing excess YEED, and dumped it into other YEED pools for USDT, HO and ZEED, sold for USDT.
notes: The three reward pairs and their swap-pair flags are set in the constructor; the later activate() call only opened trading. Skim loops between the reward pairs appear in no other transaction.

Victims are the YEED pools the minted YEED was dumped into: one paid USDT, the others HO and ZEED, which the attacker sold in the same transaction for USDT; HO and ZEED are valued at those realised USDT proceeds (rule 12), since the dumps crashed both markets.
